repos_data.description: Build and distribute Linux packages from sources in an automatic, consistent and reproducible way #obs

A modular, lazy-loaded recovery tool for Linux. Instead of manually searching wikis when a command fails, Mend uses fzf to resolve package conflicts, map missing libraries, and clear database locks across Arch, Fedora, openSUSE, and Debian-based systems.
